title: Excel Sheet Column Title
description: Given a positive integer `columnNumber`, return its corresponding spreadsheet column title (where 1 -> `"A"`, 26 -> `"Z"`, 27 -> `"AA"`, 701 -> `"ZY"`).
hints: Because there is no zero digit in Excel column titles, subtract 1 from columnNumber before taking modulo 26.
Append chr(ord('A') + rem), divide by 26, and reverse the collected characters at the end.
